title: Combine acceleration signature transfer
nfl_outcome: Context-adjusted in-game acceleration (play max_a / time-to-speed from frames)
confounders: Route/assignment mix, play context (down, distance), scheme, fatigue, injuries, age.
selection_bias: Only drafted / rostered athletes appear in NFL tracking (survivorship); opportunity varies by depth chart.
validation: Grouped-by-athlete CV; cohort holdout (train 2023-24 cohorts, test 2025); compare vs 40/10-yd baseline.
football_interpretation: Does the *shape* of acceleration (not the 40 time) carry over to how quickly a player reaches speed in games?
limitations: In-game acceleration is rarely maximal; needs event windows (e.g., snap → +2 s) in Phase 02.

title: Combine agility vs in-game change of direction
matching_drills: SHORT_SHUTTLE, THREE_CONE_DRILL, OL_PULL_DRILL_FOLD_BLOCK_RIGHT, FOUR_BAG_AGILITY_DRILL, BODY_CONTROL_DRILL, OL_PULL_DRILL_DEEP_SHORT_PULL_LEFT, OL_PULL_DRILL_LONG_PULL_RIGHT, SHUFFLE_SPRINT_AND_COD_DRILL
nfl_outcome: Braking + re-acceleration around direction changes in game frames
confounders: Route tree / coverage assignment; defender leverage; game state.
selection_bias: Many athletes skip agility drills (see participation heatmap) → non-random missingness.
validation: Athlete-grouped CV within position; sensitivity to direction-change threshold definitions.
football_interpretation: Is Combine change-of-direction quality visible in route breaks / coverage transitions?
limitations: Requires robust heading-change detection on noisy tracking (smoothing study first).

title: Defensive line explosiveness
positions: DL, DE, DT, EDGE, IDL, NT
nfl_outcome: player_get_off / time_to_pressure from player_play; first-step speed after snap from frames
confounders: Alignment (lined_up_position), stunts, double teams, pass vs run, down & distance.
selection_bias: Get-off only defined on pass-rush snaps; rotational players have fewer snaps.
validation: Athlete-grouped CV; adjust for alignment; bootstrap CIs clustered by athlete.
football_interpretation: Do Combine burst signatures predict how fast DL get off the ball in games?
limitations: Snap timing precision (10 Hz) bounds get-off resolution (~0.1 s).

title: Athletic outlier identification
matching_drills: FORTY_YARD_DASH, SHORT_SHUTTLE, THREE_CONE_DRILL, BOX_DRILL, BACK_PEDAL_AND_90_DEGREE_BREAK_TO_BALL, BACK_PEDAL_AND_TRANSITION_45_DEGREE_REACTION, W_DRILL, FIVE_YARD_WAVE_DRILL_SLIDE_AND_SHUFFLE
nfl_outcome: Career outcomes (snaps, starts) — targets only, with exposure-length adjustment
confounders: Draft capital (round/pick) strongly drives opportunity; team needs; injuries.
selection_bias: Career length differs by cohort (2025 cohort has ≤1 season) → right-censoring.
validation: Within-cohort comparisons; control for draft pick; temporal holdout.
football_interpretation: Which athletes move unusually well relative to their traditional scores, and does it matter?
limitations: Outcome = opportunity, not pure performance; requires censoring-aware analysis.

title: Position-specific movement profiles
matching_drills: FORTY_YARD_DASH, SHORT_SHUTTLE, THREE_CONE_DRILL, BOX_DRILL, BACK_PEDAL_AND_90_DEGREE_BREAK_TO_BALL, BACK_PEDAL_AND_TRANSITION_45_DEGREE_REACTION, W_DRILL, FIVE_YARD_WAVE_DRILL_SLIDE_AND_SHUFFLE
confounders: Role within position (slot vs outside WR, nickel vs boundary CB).
selection_bias: Position labels differ between Combine and NFL (see dim_position crosswalk).
validation: Stability across seasons; split-half reliability of profiles.
football_interpretation: Do transfer relationships differ by position (pooled vs position-aware models)?
limitations: Small positions (K/P/LS) are not analysable; group positions sensibly.
